_what: FWO-6 conversion-point register. A map of where each named exit attempt re-entered the single medium. No entry is evaluated; the tally counts.
_fields: id; changed = which of account / ledger / exchange / production the attempt altered; reconversions = list of {mechanism, layer, source}; mechanism in tax / input_purchase / credential / legal_recognition / publication / settlement / UNKNOWN; layer in settlement / production / credential / legal / publication / UNKNOWN; source starts with CARRIED / VERIFIED / CONSTRUCTED / READ / UNKNOWN
_sampling_boundary: every source is CARRIED from memory or from the order; no publisher, registry or agency host is reachable under the egress allowlist (github.com only). What that selects for: attempts prominent enough to be known without a search, in the United States, in English.
_prior_art: complementary-currency literature and Ostrom-lineage commons scholarship: NOT_RUN (hosts unreachable). A failure-point taxonomy may exist there; if it does, this register is to be re-keyed to it, not kept beside it.
